auto_switch.title: Low-quota account switching
auto_switch.description: Prepare a backup account when the reserve threshold is reached. Credentials change only after both Antigravity and agy have exited. This tool never stops tasks or forcibly closes clients.
auto_switch.enable: Enable low-quota switching (takes effect after saving)
auto_switch.strategy_round_robin_desc: Rotates sequentially down the list in a circular chain. Ideal for pooling quotas evenly.
auto_switch.strategy_priority_desc: Always selects the highest-priority eligible account from the top of the list.
auto_switch.wait_instructions: Let your tasks finish, then quit Antigravity and agy normally. The tool switches accounts after it observes both clients have exited.
auto_switch.stop_instructions: Stop the current task in Antigravity, check that background work has ended, then quit the clients normally. The tool completes the switch afterward.
auto_switch.reserve: Prepare to switch at remaining quota (%)
auto_switch.accounts_hint: Only selected accounts are eligible, in list order. You may include the current account; it is skipped during selection. Maximum 10.
auto_switch.no_accounts: Add accounts and refresh their quotas first.
auto_switch.safety_note: The reserve may not last until a task finishes. Switching does not restore running commands or continue a conversation automatically. Do not launch clients while the switch is committing.
auto_switch.load_failed: Could not load settings or accounts. Please try again.
auto_switch.status_failed: Could not read switch status. Check Settings.
auto_switch.action_failed: The action did not complete. Refresh status before retrying.
auto_switch.stop_step_1: Use the native Stop control in the target Antigravity conversation. In the CLI, use the cancellation control supported by your installed version.
auto_switch.stop_step_2: Check that the task, background commands and subagents have ended, then quit all Antigravity and agy clients normally. Do not force-kill processes.
auto_switch.stop_step_3: Keep this tool running. After the switch, reopen the client, verify the account and open the original conversation from history. Continue manually.
auto_switch.stop_warning: This button only shows instructions; it does not send a stop command. A stopped tool may have partially completed an action. Review the results before continuing.
auto_switch.manual_continue: Reopen the client, verify the account, open the original conversation from history and continue manually. No automatic restart, conversation restore or tool replay occurs.

reasons.no_current_account: No current account identified. Sync or select one first.
reasons.no_quota: No usable quota data; switching is paused
reasons.stale_quota: Quota data is stale; waiting for a refresh
reasons.unknown_pool: Cannot confirm every applicable quota window; switching is paused
reasons.no_candidate: No backup account has enough available quota
reasons.clients_running: Clients are still open; waiting to switch safely
reasons.process_unknown: Cannot confirm the clients have exited; switching is paused
reasons.credentials_changed: Client credentials differ from the recorded account. Sync accounts again.
reasons.source_changed: The current account changed; this switch was stopped
reasons.canceled_until_recovery: Switch canceled until quota recovers. Save settings to re-enable sooner.
reasons.switch_failed: Switch incomplete; credentials may be partially updated. Check accounts before re-enabling.
reasons.credentials_updated: Account ready; takes effect when you reopen the client
reasons.checking: Rechecking and switching; do not launch clients
reasons.ready: Clients have exited; completing the switch shortly
reasons.unsupported_client: This client version does not support this safe switching mode
reasons.state_unavailable: Cannot read or save switch state; switching is paused
